Nina Park: heads up 1 — I legally changed my last name last week (Park-Santos) and updated payroll, but my Redwood digital ID still shows "Nina Park". Im traveling to Portugal tomorrow and the pharmacist says they need the name on the card to match my passport to release a controlled prescription. Help?

Maya - People Ops: Congrats on the name change! Quick checklist: 1) we need a copy of the name-change document (marriage cert or court order) uploaded to the Benefits Portal > Documents > Identity Changes, 2) request a digital ID reissue and temporary letter of coverage for travel. Upload now and we can fast-track same-day in most cases. Please DM the file (dont post personal docs here).

Nina Park: Uploaded marriage_certificate_nina_2026.pdf to portal 07:10AM and DM'd it. Pharmacist is insisting on exact match to passport; they're refusing to release without matching last name or an official letter from insurer.

Benefits Bot: Received document upload for Nina Park at 2026-03-23T07:12:34Z. Action: People Ops will initiate Name Variation / Reissue request. For travel emergencies you can request a Temporary Coverage Letter (PDF) under Benefits Portal > Travel & Coverage > Urgent Letters. Processing SLA for urgent letters: same business day if submitted before 11:00 AM PT.

Pharmacy Ops: If pharmacy requires insurer letter, we can generate an insurer-attested "Member Identity Confirmation" once People Ops confirms the name-change docs. The letter will state: "Member known as Nina Park-Santos (former name Nina Park), member ID #### (last 4 only)." We'll avoid posting full IDs in channel; DM only.

Nina Park: Appreciate it. Small wrinkle: my passport shows "Nina Park-Santos" but some airline docs only have "Nina Park". Will that matter for insurer letter? Also I have a local Portuguese card for the pharmacy pickup which only allows one surname field.

Maya - People Ops: The insurer letter can include both name variants (aka/also known as). That usually satisfies pharmacy and travel providers. For passport checks at border/airline, thats separate and the letter won't change official travel docs. Suggest carrying printed passport, printed insurer letter, and the digital ID screenshot. If pharmacy still balks, ask them to accept a signed provider attestation + insurer letter.

ZenithCare Rep: From carrier side: once we receive the certified name-change doc, we can update the member record and reissue a digital ID with the new name. For urgent requests we'll issue a Temporary Coverage Letter referencing both names and include plan/group info, BIN, and Rx BIN for pharmacy. ETA: 2 hours during business hours after doc verification. If outside business hours, we can issue a limited-scope attestation via email (requires member DOB + last 4 of ID sent via DM).

Nina Park: Sent DM with DOB + last 4. Pharmacist said they can hold the medication 1.5 hours. Fingers crossed.

Travel Admin: FYI if you need a travel insurance verification letter for customs or medical care, we can also put together a travel-enabled benefits summary that includes emergency contacts and in-network hospitals in Lisbon. Upload a copy of your itinerary to Travel Portal and tag us.

Maya - People Ops: Following up: once ZenithCare issues the Temporary Coverage Letter, Pharma Ops will deliver it to the pharmacy. If the pharmacy charges you out-of-pocket, keep the receipt and upload to Benefits Portal > Reimbursement. We can file for expedited reimbursement.

Pharmacy Ops: Update: pharmacy confirmed receipt of insurer attestation via secure fax and released the prescription. They logged reference code RX-PORT-221 and charged standard copay. If anything else pops up while abroad, DM us and we'll open a cross-border claims ticket.

Nina Park: Medicine picked up, thank you all!! Will upload any receipts if needed. Also thank you for the quick turnaround on the digital ID reissue.

Maya - People Ops: Closing loop 1 we will complete the member record name update and push a reissued digital ID to the portal within 48 hours. If anyone needs the temporary letter copy for records, DM me and Ill attach the secure link. Reminder: never post full member ID or passport scans in this public channel.
